> **Please do not post sensitive details of a security vulnerability in a public GitHub issue.**
>
> If this issue involves a way to exploit MediaVault, expose user data, compromise a vault, or otherwise poses a security or privacy risk, please avoid including exploit details, proof-of-concept code, or steps that could allow others to reproduce the vulnerability in this public tracker.
>
> If the repository maintainer has published a private reporting channel (for example, via GitHub's "Report a vulnerability" / Security Advisories feature on this repository), please use that instead of a public issue.
